standard.title: Automotive Vehicles — Types — Terminology (First Revision)
standard.sector: Transport Engineering / Automotive Body, Chassis, Accessories and Garage Equipment

sectional_committee.name: Automotive Body, Chassis, Accessories and Garage Equipment Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard defines terms, classifications, and nomenclature relating to various types of power-driven road vehicles (including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and quadricycles) and their trailers, establishing a standardized baseline for whole-vehicle type approval, registration, and Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) compliance across India.
standard.scope: This standard defines terms, classifications, and nomenclature relating to various types of power-driven road vehicles (including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and quadricycles) and their trailers, establishing a standardized baseline for whole-vehicle type approval, registration, and Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) compliance across India.

amendments.summary: Aligns the terminology, bodywork types (Annex A), and definitions with updated Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR) and international UNECE vehicle type approval regulations.

certification.description: Strict Statutory Mandatory Code. Under Rule 2 of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules (CMVR), 1989, all motor vehicles and trailers manufactured or registered in India must be classified and type-approved in accordance with the vehicle categories defined in IS 14272:2011 (which officially replaced the legacy industry code AIS-053:2005). Successful compliance is certified by authorized testing agencies (such as ARAI, GARC, and ICAT) via a Type Approval Certificate. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable.
requirements: Applies an additional 'G' suffix designation to M or N vehicles that satisfy strict geometric off-road requirements (such as minimum approach, departure, and ramp breakover angles, ground clearances under axles, and all-wheel drive capabilities) per IS 12218.

Specifies definitions for the type of bodywork for passenger cars of Category M1 (comprising Saloon, Hatchback, Station Wagon, Coupe, Convertible, and Multi-purpose vehicles) to standardize registration.
